verses.1: Alleluia. Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem. Praise your God, O Zion.
verses.2: For he has reinforced the bars of your gates. He has blessed your sons within you.
verses.3: He has stationed peace at your borders, and he has satisfied you with the fat of the grain.
verses.4: He sends forth his eloquence to the earth. His word runs swiftly.
verses.5: He provides snow like wool. He strews clouds like ashes.
verses.6: He sends his ice crystals like morsels. Who can stand firm before the face of his cold?
verses.7: He will send forth his word, and it will melt them. His Spirit will breathe out, and the waters will flow.
verses.8: He announces his word to Jacob, his justices and his judgments to Israel.
verses.9: He has not done so much for every nation, and he has not made his judgments manifest to them. Alleluia. [ Psalm 148 ]
